281: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
On whomever He shows mercy, to that one He gives His own Name,
and those people, O Nanak, become greatly fortunate. ॥8॥13॥
ਤਜਹੁ ਸਿਆਨਪ. ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ; ਸਿਮਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Good people, give up cleverness and remember the Lord;
ਏਕ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ. ਮਨਿ ਰਖਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
keep hope in the Lord alone in your mind. O Nanak, pain, delusion and fear then go. ॥1॥
ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਬ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Know that reliance on any person is wholly useless,
the one Lord alone is able to give,
by whose giving a person stays satisfied,
and greed does not come to press on him again.
The Lord Himself alone kills or sustains,
nothing is in a person's power.
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
So it is by understanding His command that peace comes.
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
Keep His Name in remembrance at every moment.
O Nanak, no obstacle then arises on life's journey. ॥1॥
Praise the Lord's greatness within yourself.
O my mind, carry on this true dealing.
With your tongue drink the sweet nectar of the Name,
and so make your soul happy for ever.
With your eyes behold the Lord's spectacle of the world,
in the company of the good, every other attachment fades.
With your feet walk on God's path.
Sins are removed if we repeat the Lord's Name even a little.
ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
With your hands do the work of the Lord's path, and with your ears hear His praise;
in this way, O Nanak, one stands with honour in the Lord's court. ॥2॥
Greatly fortunate in the world are those people
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
who always sing the Lord's praises.
Those who fix their attention on the Lord's Name
are the wealthy and the contented ones in the world.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ; ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
Those good people who utter the Lord's Name with mind, body and mouth,
know them to be always happy.
One who recognises only the one Lord everywhere
ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ; ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
comes to understand this world and the next.
ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
One whose mind has become blended with the Lord's Name,
O Nanak, has recognised the Lord. ॥3॥
One who, by the Guru's grace, comes to see his own self,
know that his craving is extinguished.
God's devotee who speaks the Lord's praise in the company of the holy
ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਤੇ; ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਤ ॥
One who every day utters nothing but the Lord's praise in song
is unattached while living as a householder.
ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
One whose hope rests on the one Lord
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
has the noose of death cut away.
One whose mind longs to meet the Lord,
O Nanak, is touched by no pain. ॥4॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
One who always keeps the Lord God in mind
is a saint, is happy, and is never unsettled.
The one on whom the Lord shows His mercy,
ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
tell me, whom can that servant fear?
To him the Lord appears just as He really is,
Himself pervading the world He has made.
By constant reflection that servant succeeds,
by the Guru's grace he understands the whole reality.
ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ; ਤਬ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
When I look, I see everything as the form of the Root of all,
O Nanak, He Himself is the unseen light within all and He Himself this visible world. ॥5॥
ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨਮੈ; ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
Nothing is born and nothing dies;
the Lord Himself is playing this play.
Birth and death, the seen and the unseen,
this whole creation He has made obedient to His command.
282: He alone is in all beings,
in countless ways He makes the world and also destroys it.
The Lord is imperishable, nothing of Him is destroyed,
and He Himself is fashioning the whole universe.
The glory of that all-pervading Lord cannot be fathomed or described;
O Nanak, only if He Himself causes them to repeat His Name do beings repeat it. ॥6॥
Those who have recognised the Lord have become honoured;
the whole world is saved from vices by their teachings.
The Lord's devotees are able to save all,
and have the power to remove everyone's suffering.
The merciful Lord Himself unites them with Him,
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ; ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
and repeating the Guru's Word they blossom.
Only that person engages in their service
on whom, fortunate one, You Yourself show mercy, O Lord.
Repeating the Name, they reach a steady state;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ; ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, regard those people as very lofty. ॥7॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Whatever the Lord's servant does, he does within the Lord's will,
and he dwells always in the Lord's presence.
Whatever happens of itself he takes as the Lord's will,
and he understands the Lord alone as the doer of everything.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਜਨ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
What the Lord does seems sweet to His servants,
for the Lord appears to them just as He is.
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
They stay absorbed in the Lord from whom they arose,
ਓਇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
they become a treasury of comforts, and this rank befits them alone.
In honouring His servant the Lord gives honour to Himself.
O Nanak, know the Lord and His servant as one. ॥8॥14॥
ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ॥
The Lord is full of all powers and knows the pain of all beings.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, let us be an offering to Him through whose remembrance one is saved from vices. ॥1॥
The Lord, Sustainer of the world, Himself joins the broken thread of the heart back to Him.
ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
The Lord who carries in His mind the care of all,
from His door no one comes away without hope.
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
O my mind, repeat the Lord's Name always,
He is imperishable, and only He is like Himself.
Nothing a person does by his own effort is accomplished,
though he may long for it a hundred times.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮ ॥
Apart from the Lord nothing is of real use to you,
ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, repeat the Name of the one Lord and you will reach the high state. ॥1॥
Let no one who has beauty take pride in it,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ; ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
for it is the Lord's light that shines in all bodies.
Why should anyone be proud of being wealthy,
ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਦਰਬੈ ॥
when all wealth is the gift of the Lord?
If someone has himself called a great warrior,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
where can he run without the strength the Lord gives?
If someone sets himself up as a giver,
let that fool recognise the Lord who is able to give to all.
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤੂਟੈ ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
One whose disease of pride is removed by the Guru's grace,
O Nanak, that person is always free of disease. ॥2॥
As a pillar holds up the roof of a house,
ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਮਨਹਿ ਅਸਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
so the Guru's Word is the support of the mind.
As a stone crosses over when placed in a boat,
so a person attached to the Guru's feet crosses the world-ocean.
As a lamp gives light in the darkness,
ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
so the mind blossoms on seeing the Guru.
ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ; ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
As one lost in a great forest finds the path,
ਤਿਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ; ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
so the Lord's light appears within when one sits in the company of the holy.
I ask for the dust of the feet of those saints.
O Lord, fulfil this wish of Nanak. ॥3॥
Foolish mind, why do you wail?
283: One has to eat the fruit of what was sown before.
The Lord Himself is the giver of pain and comfort,
so leave other supports and remember Him alone.
ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Whatever He does, take that as comfort.
Ignorant one, why do you wander astray?
Greedy moth, you are engrossed in the taste of Maya.
Repeat the Lord's Name in your heart,
O Nanak, and you will go with honour to the home beyond. ॥4॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ; ਲੈਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
The merchandise you came into the world to buy,
the Lord's Name, is found in the home of the saints.
Give up pride and buy it in exchange for your mind,
and assay the Lord's Name in your heart.
Load this merchandise and travel with the saints,
and give up the other entanglements of Maya.
Then everyone will say "well done" to you,
and in the Lord's court too your face will be bright.
But only a rare person carries on this trade.
O Nanak, let us always be an offering to such a one. ॥5॥
ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ; ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
Wash the feet of the holy and drink the water of the Name,
offer up your very life to the holy one.
Bathe in the dust of the feet of one who follows the Guru,
and give yourself up to him.
Service of the saint is obtained by great good fortune,
only in the saint's company can the Lord's praise be sung.
The saint protects from the many obstacles on the path of spiritual life,
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
singing the Lord's virtues, the saint relishes the nectar of the Name.
One who has taken the saints' support and fallen at their door
has found all comforts, O Nanak. ॥6॥
The Lord is able to bring the dead to life,
and gives support to the hungry too.
ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
All treasures lie within the Master's glance,
yet beings reap the fruit of their own past deeds.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ; ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Everything is His, and He alone is able to do everything;
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
there is no other besides Him, nor will there be.
ਜਪਿ ਜਨ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
O servant, remember the Lord always, day and night,
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
this deed is higher and purer than all other deeds.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
The one to whom He mercifully grants the Name,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
One in whose mind faith in the Guru has formed
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
has the Lord settle in his heart.
He is heard of throughout the world as a devotee,
the one in whose heart the one Lord dwells;
ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
the way he lives and the principles he holds are one and the same,
the true Lord is in his heart, and the Lord's Name alone is what his mouth utters;
his sight is dyed in the true Lord, so the whole visible world appears to him as the Lord's form,
he sees the Lord present everywhere and the whole expanse as the Lord's.
One who has known the Supreme Lord as true and ever-abiding,
O Nanak, is absorbed for ever in that True, ever-abiding One. ॥8॥15॥
ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ. ਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
The Lord has no form, no mark and no colour; He is unstained by the three qualities of Maya.
ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, He makes Himself understood to the one with whom He is pleased. ॥1॥
Keep the imperishable Lord threaded in your mind,
and give up attachment to man.
ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Outside Him there is no being and no thing,
the one Lord alone pervades within all beings.
He Himself sees and Himself knows the hearts of beings,
the Lord is very profound, deep and wise.
O Supreme Lord, great Master of all, Sustainer of beings,
treasury of mercy, home of compassion, forgiving one,
may I fall at the feet of Your holy ones,
284: this is the longing in Nanak's mind. ॥1॥
The Lord is able to fulfil the mind's desires and to help those who come to His shelter.
What He has written on the hand of each being is what happens.
ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੋਰੁ ॥
The Lord for whom the blink of an eye is enough to destroy and sustain the world,
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
His hidden secret no one else knows.
ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ; ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
The Lord in whose home there is always bliss and joy,
ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ; ਸੁਨੀਅਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
all the things of the world are heard to be in His home.
ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ; ਜੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
Among kings the Lord Himself is king, among yogis the yogi,
ਤਪ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੀਸਰੁ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
among ascetics He is the great ascetic, and among householders He is the householder.
His devotees have found peace by remembering Him again and again.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, no being has found the limit of that Lord. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਕੀ; ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
The Lord whose play of the world no one can reckon,
all the gods have grown weary searching for Him;
ਪਿਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ; ਕਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
for what does a son know of his father's birth?
The Lord has strung the whole creation on the thread of His own command.
Those to whom the Lord gives good sense, high understanding and the gift of focused attention,
those servants and slaves remember His Name.
ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
But those whom He makes wander in the three qualities of Maya
keep being born and dying, coming and going again and again.
The hearts of the high and the minds of the low are all His own dwelling places.
O Nanak, as is the understanding He gives, so does a being come to understand. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ; ਨਾਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
O Lord, You who have many forms and colours,
put on many guises and yet remain one and the same.
He has spread out the world in many ways,
the Lord is imperishable, and everywhere He is the One alone.
The Lord performs many wonders in an instant,
that perfect Being pervades every place.
The Lord has fashioned the creation in many ways,
He Himself alone knows the worth of His greatness.
ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ; ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਠਾਉ ॥
All bodies are His, all places are His.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
O Nanak, His servant lives by repeating His Name. ॥4॥
All creatures rest on the Lord's support,
all the regions of the world are held in place by the Lord.
ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ; ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
The Smritis, Vedas and Puranas rest on the Lord,
ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ; ਸੁਨਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
listening to wisdom and fixing the attention also rest on the Lord's support.
All the skies and underworlds rest on the Lord,
all bodies rest on the Lord's support.
ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ; ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਭਵਨ ॥
The three worlds and fourteen realms are held in place by the Lord,
ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਉਧਰੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
joined to the Lord and hearing His Name with their ears, beings are saved from vices.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ; ਆਪਨੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
The one He mercifully joins to His Name,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, reaches the fourth stage, beyond Maya's influence, and attains the high state. ॥5॥
ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
The Lord whose form and abode are ever-abiding,
He alone, the all-pervading Lord, is over all.
ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਸਤਿ; ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Unfailing are the deeds of that ever-abiding Lord whose word
pervades all beings, He who speaks in all.
ਸਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਤਿ ॥
Ever-lasting is the grace of Him whose creation is complete,
who is the ever-abiding root of all and whose bringing-forth is complete.
The Lord's will is supremely pure,
to the one He gives understanding of it, that will seems wholly comforting.
The Lord's ever-abiding Name is the giver of comfort.
ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਸਤਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
O Nanak, this unfailing faith is obtained from the Guru. ॥6॥
The Guru's teachings are unfailing words,
ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥
and those whose hearts they enter become abiding too, free from birth and death.
If someone gains insight into love for the ever-abiding Lord,
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
then by repeating the Name he reaches the high state.
The Lord Himself is ever-abiding, and the world He has made is real too, not an illusion.
The Lord Himself knows His own state and extent.
285: He whose creation this world is, is Himself its Maker,
do not think that anyone else takes thought for it.
ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
The one He has made cannot measure the Creator's greatness.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਵਰਤੀਆ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, only what pleases Him comes about. ॥7॥
They are struck with wonder and amazement at His greatness;
whoever has understood it has tasted the joy.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ; ਰਾਚਿ ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
God's servants stay absorbed in God's love,
and through the Guru's teaching they gain the treasure of the Name.
They themselves give out the gift of the Name and cut away suffering,
in their company the creatures of the world cross over.
One who becomes the servant of such servants is very fortunate,
ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
in their company the mind is joined to the One.
God's servant sings God's virtues and praises Him.
O Nanak, by the Guru's grace he gains the fruit of the Name. ॥8॥16॥
The Lord exists from the very beginning, He is there from the start of the ages.
ਹੈ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
He exists now, O Nanak, and will remain for ever after. ॥1॥
The Lord's feet are ever-abiding, and the servants who touch them become unshakeable too;
His worship is a work that lasts for ever, and those who worship become unshakeable for ever.
Seeing the Lord is a lasting act, and those who see Him are freed from birth and death;
His Name is ever unshakeable, and those who meditate on it are steady too.
He Himself ever exists, and the creation He upholds exists as well;
He Himself is virtue, and He Himself brings virtue into being.
The word of His praise lasts for ever, and the one who utters it becomes steady too,
fixing the mind on the Lord is a lasting act, and one who hears His praise is lasting too.
To one who understands His existence, the world He has made is seen to be real as well;
O Nanak, the Lord Himself abides for ever. ॥1॥
One who has always kept the form of the unshakeable Lord in his heart
has recognised the root of the world, who does all and makes all do.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥
One in whose heart faith in God's existence has taken hold,
in his mind real knowledge has come to light;
free of every fear, he lives unafraid,
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
for he stays merged in the One from whom he came.
As when one thing is taken and mixed into another of its kind,
ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਿੰਨ; ਨ ਕਹਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
so he cannot be called separate from the Lord.
But only a rare one who reflects on this understands it.
O Nanak, those who have met the Lord have become one with Him. ॥2॥
The Lord's servant walks in His command,
ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
In the mind of the Lord's servant there is faith in His existence,
ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
and so his way of life is pure.
The servant knows his Master to be with him at all times,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
and lives in the joy of His Name.
God is always able to look after His servant,
and the Formless One guards His servant's honour.
ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
But only he is a servant on whom God Himself shows mercy;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, such a servant remembers God with every breath. ॥3॥
and without fail guards his honour.
and has him repeat His Name.
ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ; ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
God Himself keeps His servant's good name,
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
no one can gauge his high state or his greatness.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ; ਕੋ. ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
No one can equal God's servant,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ; ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
for God's servants are higher than the highest.
But the one whom God Himself has set to His service,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
O Nanak, that servant is made known through the whole world. ॥4॥
The tiny ant into which God puts strength
reduces armies of hundreds of thousands and millions to ash.
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾਸੁ; ਨ ਕਾਢਤ ਆਪਿ ॥
The creature whose breath He does not Himself take away,
286: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ; ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥
He keeps safe, giving His hand.
A person makes efforts of many kinds,
but without God's help his works go to waste.
ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one but God can kill or protect; there is no other like Him;
He Himself is the protector of all creatures.
O living being, why do you worry?
O Nanak, meditate on God, the unseen and wondrous. ॥5॥
Let us meditate on God again and again,
ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਪੀਐ ॥
and by drinking the nectar of the Name satisfy this mind and the body's senses.
The Guru's follower who has found the jewel of the Name
sees nothing anywhere other than God;
the Name is his wealth, the Name his beauty and colour,
ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
the Name is his comfort, and he keeps the company of the Lord's Name always.
Those who are filled by the taste of the Name,
their minds and bodies stay joined to the Name alone.
To meditate on the Name while rising, sitting and sleeping,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕਾਮ ॥੬॥
Says Nanak: this is ever the occupation of His servants. ॥6॥
Sing God's praises with your tongue day and night,
this gift of praise God has given to His own servants;
they worship with an inner eagerness,
and stay joined to their God.
Whatever is happening, the servant knows it as God's will,
and he recognises his God's command;
what greatness of such a servant can I tell?
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਹਿ; ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
I do not know how to describe even one of his virtues.
Those who live in God's presence through all eight watches,
Says Nanak: they are complete vessels. ॥7॥
ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
O my mind, take shelter with them,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
and offer your body and mind to them.
The one who has recognised his God
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
becomes able to give all things.
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
In his shelter you will find every comfort,
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ; ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਾਵਹਿ ॥
by the sight of him you will be rid of all sins.
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਤੂ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
and throw yourself into the service of that servant.
Your coming and going will cease.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ; ਪੂਜਹੁ ਸਦ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
O Nanak, always worship the feet of that holy one. ॥8॥17॥
ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
One who has known the ever-abiding, all-pervading Lord is called the True Guru,
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ. ਸਿਖੁ ਉਧਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
in his company the Sikh is saved from vices; O Nanak, you too sing the Lord's virtues. ॥1॥
The True Guru protects the Sikh,
the Guru is always merciful to his servant.
ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
The Guru removes the filth of his Sikh's bad thinking,
for through the Guru's teaching the Sikh meditates on the Lord's Name.
The True Guru cuts his Sikh's bonds of Maya,
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ; ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੈ ॥
and the Guru's Sikh turns away from vices;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ; ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
for the True Guru gives his Sikh the wealth of the Name,
and so the Guru's Sikh becomes very fortunate.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਸਿਖ ਕਾ; ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
The True Guru sets right this world and the next for his Sikh.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ; ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the True Guru keeps his Sikh in mind as he does his own life. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
The servant who stays at the Guru's door to learn,
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
and accepts the Guru's command in his mind;
ਆਪਸ ਕਉ; ਕਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
who does not make himself out to be great,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
and always meditates on the Lord's Name in his heart;
who sells his mind to the True Guru, handing it over to him,
all that servant's tasks are accomplished.
The servant who serves the Guru wanting no reward
287: The one on whom God Himself shows His mercy,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਇ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, that servant takes the Guru's teaching. ॥2॥
ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
The servant who wholly convinces his True Guru of his faith
ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
comes to understand the state of the Supreme Lord.
ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
The True Guru is the one in whose heart the Lord's Name dwells,
ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ; ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
many times over I give myself up to such a Guru.
He is the giver of every treasure and of spiritual life,
for through all eight watches he is dyed in the love of the Supreme Lord.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ; ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
The servant, the Guru, stays joined to God, and God ever rests in him,
the Guru and God are one in form; there is no mistake in this.
Such a Guru is not found by a thousand clever tricks,
O Nanak, he is found by great good fortune. ॥3॥
The sight of the Guru yields every fruit; seeing him, one becomes pure,
by touching his feet one gains a high state and a clean way of living.
Staying in the Guru's company, one is able to sing God's virtues,
and reaches the court of the Supreme Lord.
Hearing the Guru's words, the ears are satisfied,
contentment comes to the mind and the soul is assured.
ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ; ਅਖੵਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ॥
The True Guru is perfect, and his teaching too is unshakeable for ever,
the one he looks on with his life-giving glance becomes a saint.
The Guru's virtues are endless; no price can be set on them.
ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
O Nanak, the one who pleases God He unites with the Guru. ॥4॥
The tongue is one, but the Lord's virtues are countless,
He who is perfect, ever-abiding and all-pervading.
By no words can a person reach His virtues,
God is beyond reach, beyond the body's senses, and free of desire.
He needs no food, He is without enmity, and gives comfort to all,
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
no one has been able to set a value on Him.
Countless devotees bow to Him always,
and remember His lotus feet in their hearts.
I give myself up for ever to my True Guru,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, by whose grace such a God can be meditated on. ॥5॥
ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Only a rare person enjoys this taste of the Lord's Name,
he drinks the nectar of the Name and becomes deathless.
ਉਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
in whose mind the Lord, the treasury of virtues, shines out.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Through all eight watches the True Guru meditates on the Lord's Name,
and gives his servant this same true teaching.
ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ॥
He is never tied to attachment to Maya,
ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
he always keeps the One Lord settled in his mind.
The one within whom the lamp of the Name turns the darkness of ignorance to light,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ; ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੬॥
O Nanak, his delusion and the sufferings born of attachment are gone. ॥6॥
In the midst of the burning of vices God has spread coolness within us,
there is nothing but comfort, brother, and sufferings have fled,
and the fears and worries of birth and death are wiped out,
all through the Guru's perfect teaching.
Fear is finished and we now live unafraid,
ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਖੈ ਨਸੇ ॥
all ailments are destroyed and gone from the mind.
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
The Guru to whom we belonged has shown us kindness;
by repeating the Lord's Name in the company of the holy,
we have gained peace, and our delusions and wanderings are over.
ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, they ended on hearing the Lord's praise with the ears. ॥7॥
He Himself is apart from Maya's three qualities, and He Himself is the form of this world of three qualities,
the Lord who by setting up His power has enchanted the whole world.
God Himself has made His own plays,
and He Himself sets the worth of His greatness.
There is no other like the Lord,
He Himself is present within all.
Like warp and weft He runs through all forms and colours;
this understanding dawns in the Guru's company.
288: Having made the creation, God has placed His own power in it.
O Nanak, many times over I give myself up to such a Lord. ॥8॥18॥
ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ. ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Nothing goes with a person except meditation on God; all Maya is as ash.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, earning the Lord's Name is the best wealth. ॥1॥
Meet with the saints and reflect on God's virtues,
meditate on the One and take the support of His Name.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
and set God's lotus feet in your heart.
That God has the power to do all and to make all do,
ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹਹੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
grasp firmly the precious thing that is His Name.
Gather this wealth and become fortunate,
this is the pure teaching of the saints.
Keep hope in the One alone in your mind,
O Nanak, all ailments will then be gone. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ; ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
The wealth for which you run about in all four directions,
ਸੋ ਧਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
that wealth you will get by serving the Lord.
ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ; ਨਿਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
Friend, the comfort you always long for,
that comfort comes from love in the company of the saints.
ਜਿਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਉ; ਕਰਹਿ ਭਲੀ ਕਰਨੀ ॥
The good name for which you do good deeds,
ਸਾ ਸੋਭਾ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ॥
to earn that good name, take shelter in the Lord.
The illness of pride that does not go by countless remedies,
that illness is cured by applying the medicine of the Lord's Name.
ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Among all treasures the Lord's Name is the finest treasure.
O Nanak, repeat it and you will be accepted in His court. ॥2॥
Wake your mind with the Lord's Name,
and the mind that runs in ten directions comes back to its place.
ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ; ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
in whose heart that Lord dwells.
The age of Kali is a hot fire; the Lord's Name is cool,
meditate on it always and find comfort.
Fear flies away and hope is fulfilled,
for by loving devotion to God the soul lights up.
The imperishable Lord comes to live in the house of that heart.
Says Nanak: the noose of Death is cut. ॥3॥
One who thinks on the praise of the Supreme Lord is truly human,
but one who is born only to die is utterly raw.
By meditating on God the round of birth and death ends;
it ends by giving up self and taking the Guru's shelter.
ਇਉ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ; ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
In this way the precious human birth is made fruitful.
Meditate on the Lord; this is the support of life's breath.
Countless efforts cannot save one from coming and going;
nor does studying the Smritis, Shastras and Vedas.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Worship the Lord alone with your whole mind.
O Nanak, one who does so gains the fruits his mind desires. ॥4॥
why do you cling to it, foolish mind?
ਇਨ ਤੇ. ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ; ਕਵਨ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
tell me, which of these will stand by you?
Rule, revelry and the display of Maya;
tell me, attachment to which of these gives lasting release?
Riding on horses, elephants and chariots;
all this is false show, and the one who stages it will perish too.
ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਨ. ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
The fool does not recognise the Lord who gave all these things,
and forgetting the Name, O Nanak, he repents in the end. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ; ਤੂੰ ਲੇਹਿ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
Ignorant one, take the Guru's teaching and walk by it,
without devotion even the very wise drown in vices.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
O mind, my friend, worship the Lord,
and your awareness will become pure.
Keep God's lotus feet threaded in your mind,
289: and the sins of many births will be destroyed.
Repeat the Name yourself and inspire others to repeat it,
by hearing it, speaking it and living purely you will reach a high state.
ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
The Lord's Name is the finest of all things;
so, O Nanak, settled in inner poise, sing His virtues with love. ॥6॥
As you sing God's virtues your filth of vices will wash off,
and the spread of the poison of pride will vanish.
You will be free of worry and your life will pass in comfort,
remember the Lord's Name with every breath.
O mind, give up all cleverness,
in the company of the holy you will find the wealth that stays with you for ever.
Gather the capital of the Lord's Name and make this your trade.
You will have comfort in this life and respect in the Lord's court.
See the One Lord within all beings.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
Says Nanak: only one with good fortune on his forehead does this. ॥7॥
Repeat the One and praise the One alone,
meditate on the One and, O mind, long to meet the One.
Sing the endless virtues of the One alone,
in your mind and through the body's senses repeat the One God.
Everywhere the Lord Himself is the one and only,
it is God who dwells in all beings.
The world's many expanses have come from the One,
by meditating on the One, sins are destroyed.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
One whose mind and body are threaded through with the One God,
O Nanak, by the Guru's grace he has recognised that One. ॥8॥19॥
ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ; ਪਰਿਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
O God, after wandering and wandering I have come and fallen at Your shelter.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
O God, this is Nanak's request: join me to Your devotion. ॥1॥
O God, this beggar, Your servant, begs the gift of Your Name;
O Lord, in Your mercy give me Your Name.
I ask for the dust of the feet of the holy,
O Supreme Lord, fulfil my wish.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
May I sing God's virtues for ever.
O God, may I meditate on You alone with every breath.
May my love stay fixed on God's lotus feet,
ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
and may I go on worshipping God always.
The Name is my one shelter and my one support,
Nanak asks for the excellent Name of God. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
By God's glance of mercy there is great comfort,
but only a rare person tastes the Lord's Name.
Those who have tasted it are filled and want no more of Maya,
they have become complete people and never waver.
They stay full to the brim with the joy of the taste of God's love,
in the company of the holy an eagerness to meet God arises in them.
Leaving every other support, they take God's shelter,
light comes within them, and their attention stays fixed on Him at all hours.
Those of great good fortune have meditated on God.
O Nanak, there is comfort in being dyed in the Name. ॥2॥
The cravings of the servant's mind come to an end
when he takes pure teaching from his Guru.
God shows mercy to such a servant,
Breaking Maya's chains, the servant goes free,
his pain of birth and death and his doubt are over.
The servant's wish and longing are all fulfilled,
he sees God, present everywhere, always at his side.
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
The Master whose servant he becomes joins him to Himself,
O Nanak, through devotion the servant stays settled in the Name. ॥3॥
ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
Why should one forget the Lord who does not let a person's labour go to waste,
ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
who keeps in mind what one has done?
290: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
Why forget Him who has given everything,
ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
who is the support of beings' life?
ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Why forget Him who protects us in the fire of the womb?
Only a rare person understands this by the Guru's grace.
ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿ. ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
Why forget Him who rescues us from the poison of Maya,
and joins back to Himself one separated for many births?
Those to whom the perfect Guru has made this plain,
O Nanak, have remembered their Lord. ॥4॥
O friends, O saints, do this work:
leave all else and repeat God's Name.
Remember Him always and gain happiness by it;
repeat the Name yourselves and lead others to repeat it.
By love in God's devotion the world-ocean is crossed;
without devotion this body is of no use.
God's Name is the treasury of good fortune and every comfort;
one who is drowning finds a hold and a resting place,
So, O Nanak, repeat the Name, the treasury of virtues. ॥5॥
One in whom love for God has arisen, with the taste and eagerness of that love,
has this one desire in mind and body.
Seeing the Guru with his eyes he finds peace,
and washing the Guru's feet his mind blossoms.
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
God's love stays in the minds and bodies of His devotees,
but only a rare fortunate one gains their company.
O God, in Your mercy give us one thing, the Name,
so that by the Guru's grace we may repeat it.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
O Nanak, that Lord is present everywhere. ॥6॥
O forgiving God, merciful to the poor,
master of the masterless, Gobind, Gopal,
first of all and all-pervading, source of the world, Creator,
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ; ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
setting love for You in his mind with devotion.
We are low, ignorant and without virtue;
O Nanak, we have come to Your shelter, O Lord God. ॥7॥
He has, as it were, gained all the heavens and liberation,
ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
who has sung God's praises even for the blink of an eye.
He has, as it were, received many kingdoms, pleasures and honours,
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ; ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
to whose mind talk of God's Name is sweet.
He has, as it were, gained many kinds of food, clothes and music,
whose tongue always repeats God's Name.
His conduct alone is good, he alone has honour and he alone is wealthy,
in whose heart the perfect Guru's teaching dwells.
O God, give me a place in the company of Your saints.
O Nanak, there all comforts come to light. ॥8॥20॥
ਸਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ; ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
The Formless One is Himself the world of the three qualities and Himself beyond them, and Himself rests in thought-free absorption.
ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, He Himself has made the creation and He Himself remembers Himself in it. ॥1॥
ਜਬ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ; ਕਛੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
When no form of this world was yet to be seen,
ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ; ਤਬ. ਕਹ ਤੇ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
who was there then to commit sin or earn merit?
When God was Himself in thought-free absorption,
ਤਬ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ; ਕਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
who then could bear enmity or opposition towards whom?
ਜਬ ਇਸ ਕਾ; ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
When no colour or mark of this world was visible,
ਤਬ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ; ਕਹੁ. ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
tell me, whom could joy or worry then touch?
When the Supreme Lord was all by Himself alone,
ਤਬ ਮੋਹ ਕਹਾ; ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਰਮ ॥
where was attachment then, and who could be deluded?
